{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Mexico|Mexican cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Tex-Mex cuisine|Tex-Mex cuisine]]
==Ingredients==
* 6 dried ''ancho'' [[Cookbook:Chiles|chilies]]
*1–2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]] water
*6 tomatoes, peeled, seeded and coarsely-[[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] OR 2 cups canned Roma tomatoes, drained and chopped
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] finely-[[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
*½ tsp [[Cookbook:Epazote|epazote]], crumbled
*[[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*¼ tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
*5 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Cream|cream]] or [[Cookbook:Half and Half|half-and-half]]
*6 ''chorizo'' [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausages]], skinned and [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] OR ¾ [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] spiced pork, chicken or turkey sausage, skinned and chopped
*1 cup crumbled queso blanco OR freshly-grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]
*12 [[Cookbook:Tortilla|tortillas]]
*½ cup chopped [[Cookbook:Green Onion|green onions]]

==Procedure==

# Soak the chilies in boiling water for 30 minutes.
# Wearing gloves, stem, seed and cut the chilies into small pieces.
# Put the chilies and 1 cup of soaking water in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]] and [[Cookbook:Puréeing|purée]] at high speed for 20 seconds.
# Add the tomatoes, onions, garlic, epazote, sugar, salt, and black pepper and blend to a smooth purée.
# In a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]], add 1 tablespoon of olive oil and heat over high heat for 3 minutes.
# Pour in the tomato sauce and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Remove from the heat.
#In a small bowl, beat the eggs with the cream or half-and-half until well blended.
# Slowly pour the egg and cream into the pan with the sauce, stirring constantly. Cover and set aside.
#In another frying pan, [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] the sausage meat over moderate heat for 5 minutes or so, until they are lightly browned.
# With a slotted spoon, remove the sausage from the pan and drain on [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|paper towels]]. Discard the fat in the frying pan.
# Place the sausages in a small bowl and stir in 3 tablespoons of sauce and ½ cup cheese.
#Heat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F.
# In a heavy frying pan, fry the tortillas, one at a time, in very hot olive oil as follows:
##Dip a tortilla in the tomato sauce.
##Fry for a minute each side in the pan.
##Remove the tortilla to a warm plate and place about ¼ cup of sausage mixture in the centre.
##Roll up the tortilla with the filling inside.
#Place filled tortillas in a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]], seam side down. Pour the rest of the tomato sauce over them.
#Sprinkle the top with the green onions and ½ cup cheese.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for about 15 minutes or until the cheese has melted and the top has browned lightly.
==Notes, tips, and variations==
* Always wear glove when handling hot chillies and do not touch your face or eyes when doing so.
* 3 cups of leftover cooked chicken or pork may be substituted for the sausage; in this case, do not brown it but add it to the tomato sauce directly.
